title: OGE Stock Model
description: The detailed model behind each graph node. Feeds the qualitative sidecar. Matches examples/gordian_knot_stocks.json. The value field is named 'node_value' (0-1) to match the graph-update skill's stock format; 'inverted' and 'stock_type' are extra fields the creation side needs and the update side can ignore.

pmesii.description: the fixed PMESII-P dimension (Physical = Physical Environment)

unit.description: display unit + note on how it maps to the scale

node_value.description: starting value on the 0-1 scale (shared field name with the graph-update skill). The graph's starting_value is this x 100.

inverted.description: true when a lower value is the good state (a threat or compromise stock)

stock_type.description: one of the 9 stock types from the questions in guide/1-how-the-model-works.md. The graph's node behavior (the 'type' field: Level/Lever/Accumulator/Drifter) is derived from this.
